name: State Machine Diagram
description: State Machine Diagram describes the lifecycle states of an object or system, including states, events/triggers, guard conditions, and entry/do/exit actions.
purpose: Manage complex lifecycle states and control which events are allowed to transition from which state to which state.
bestFor: Manage order, flight ticket, and payment transaction states
Design logic for vending machines, elevators, IoT sensors
Describe objects with complex lifecycle and constrained transitions
Control events allowed to transition from one state to another
notSuitableFor: Describe multi-actor/departmental workflow → use Activity Diagram
Describe messages between services over time → use Sequence Diagram
Describe high-level system functionality → use Use Case Diagram
useCases: Identify the object/system whose lifecycle needs to be described
Identify initial state and final state
Add guard conditions to allow state transitions

elements.name: State
elements.description: Static state of an object: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED

elements.name: Event/Trigger
elements.description: Event that triggers a transition: pay(), approve()

elements.name: State Action
elements.description: Action on entry/within/exit of a state: entry/sendEmail()

confusableWith.difference: State Machine focuses on the lifecycle of one object; Activity focuses on workflow flow.
State Machine does not focus on who calls whom over time but on state transitions.
